title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: OCR extracts text from images for AI analysis
summary: Hold: the page overstates who can access an investigation's extracted image text. Microsoft says reviewers who are not DSI administrators can view only investigations they are assigned to, not every investigation merely through role-group membership. The automatic OCR behaviour, billing statements and listed control paths are supported.

claims.claim: DSI introduces OCR that extracts text from images and incorporates it into investigation data for AI analysis.
claims.quote: adding optical character recognition (OCR), extracting text from images and incorporating it into investigation data. This enables AI-powered deep content analysis
